name: ai-baton
description: Environment-portable Claude Code kit: capability-gated skills and agents, an env fact store, a markdown context DB with a session registry, and a self-audit — one skill set for every machine.

user_name.title: Your name
user_name.description: How skills address and stamp you (WORKSPACE_USER): sign-queue --by, the self-assessment ledger eyebrow. Never written into the kit.

github_login.title: GitHub login
github_login.description: Your GitHub login (WORKSPACE_GITHUB_LOGIN): pr-watch drops your own events, cost-report and self-assessment query author:<login>.

tz.title: Timezone (IANA)
tz.description: The zone timestamps render in (WORKSPACE_TZ): an IANA Region/City name such as America/New_York, not an abbreviation like EDT. UTC when empty or unknown.

slack_self_dm.title: Chat self-DM channel id
slack_self_dm.description: Your own chat DM channel id (WORKSPACE_SLACK_SELF_DM), where a draft skill parks text for you. Optional; needs systems.slack in the env store.

slack_lattice_dm.title: Performance-review bot DM channel id
slack_lattice_dm.description: The chat DM your performance-review tool's bot posts in (WORKSPACE_SLACK_LATTICE_DM), read by the self-assessment skill. Optional; needs systems.slack in the env store.
